name: Flamon
source:
Race: Male crystal monster
Origin: White Mountain
Hobby: Eating fruits
Job: Traveller

A Crystal Monster from White Mountain, Flamon is different from its kind in that it can speak human language. In OASE, Flamon can be found in the Exhibition Hall with Lenz.
